name: manual_f3a22a
claim: When an operator ruling is relayed through a handoff document or a side agent, confirm the exact wording with the operator before implementing it

decisions.notes: A handoff labelled a fast-mode rule an operator decision while the live ruling was flat refusal; the two differ once an allow path exists, so repos would have diverged.

rationale: A handoff labelled a fast-mode rule an operator decision while the live ruling was flat refusal; the two differ once an allow path exists, so repos would have diverged.
